text:
alice_sales: Heads up  ACME wants a single invoice for API + Optimize (tuning + eval runs) + Console retention (90d). They prefer monthly billing but will sign a 12-month commit if we give enough fwd discount. Also asked about SAML and SOC2 artifacts.

ben_pricing: quick math: if they commit $35k/mo (annualized $420k) we can apply a 17% cross-product packaging discount. If they go to $50k/mo ($600k/yr) we can move to 24% + include a 30-day Optimize trial. I recommend showing a monthly smoothed quote and a stepped ramp (M1 50% usage then ramp).

carla_se: POC notes: hosted keys are easiest for initial eval. If they need low-latency we should propose a temporary Dedicated staging cluster (2x A100) for the latency-critical flows. Setup command Iuse for staging: `rnwctl provision --env acme-poc --dedicated --gpus 2`

devon_sec: I'll take the security questionnaire. Need SOC2 Type II, encryption-at-rest details, and a data flow diagram showing token/eval storage. If they want SAML, share IdP metadata (we can do SAML v2.0). HIPAA? call legal before promising PHI support.

elena_dd: FYI, approvals: discounts >20% require Deal Desk signoff + written commercial rationale (customer ARR, strategic value, reference potential). >30% needs CRO/VP approval. Also attach the signed commitment and any termination language. True-up policy must be included for overage.

pricingbot: internal ratecard: https://redwood.internal/ratelists/2026-q1. Standard API: $0.002/token (per 1k). Optimize tuning runs priced separately.

alice_sales: Drafting the customer quote: two line items (API + Optimize) plus Console retention as an add-on line with 90d retention flat fee or % of API spend. Which is easier for procurement?

ben_pricing: procurement likes predictable monthly numbers. Offer (A) $35k/mo smoothed invoice (17% pkg disc) with standard true-up, (B) $50k/mo smoothed (24% pkg disc) + 30d Optimize pilot. Show both and a 24-mo option with extra 3% loyalty discount.

carla_se: For the 30d pilot we should limit to eval QPS and set an ingest cap. I'll add a short POC runbook and cleanup steps so infra isn't left running.

devon_sec: I'll open a secure share for SOC2 and KMS docs. Aim to turn SQ in 5 business days if ACME responds quickly.

elena_dd: When you have the final matrix, ping me with: final $/mo, discount %, term, termination terms, and customer strategic note. Ill create the internal approval route.

alice_sales: OK team  next steps: Ill post a 1-pager by 10am PT tomorrow with monthly equivalents, ramp scenarios, and the true-up. Ben will attach the cost sensitivity and discount rationale. Carla will outline POC duration & dedicated flag. Devon will start SQ.

ben_pricing: I'll add an expected unit economics table and a sensitivity chart (showing impact if usage +20% vs -20%).

carla_se: standing by for IdP metadata if they want SAML. Also confirm whether they prefer a single tenant/log retention setting for Console.

devon_sec: ack. Starting SQ now.

elena_dd: once you drop the packet ill triage for a fast-track review this afternoon if numbers are final.

alice_sales: thanks all. tagging @elena_dd and @devon_sec for approvals and security :thumbsup:
